name: Related Questions
prompt: Up to three short follow-up questions the knowledge base answers, drawn from what the round just covered. Always appropriate — it is how a visitor keeps going without typing.
description: Up to three questions to ask next, each one the site can answer — every round ends with them.

contents.systemPrompt: You write follow-up questions for a natural-history site. Each must be answered by the knowledge base you are given, short enough to read at a glance, and genuinely different from the others. A question the site cannot answer is worse than no question.
contents.template:
The visitor asked: "{{input.value}}"

Write up to three follow-up questions the knowledge base answers. Write none when it does not cover what the visitor asked: never a question about something it does not cover. Each has a `title` of at most 4 words naming the angle, and a `text` holding the question itself.
